title: Common Utilities Module
summary: This module provides a collection of general-purpose utility functions for system interaction, string manipulation, model initialization, optimization parameter handling, and logging within the Llama.cpp ecosystem.

nodes.label: Adjust CPU Thread Parameters
nodes.title: Adjust CPU Threads
nodes.description: Adjusts the number of CPU threads for processing based on system capabilities or a reference model, ensuring optimal resource utilization and logging potential performance issues.

nodes.label: Retrieve Cache File Path
nodes.title: Cache File Path
nodes.description: Generates the full path for a cache file within the application's designated cache directory, creating the directory if it does not already exist.

nodes.label: Initialize Llama Model & Context
nodes.title: Model & Context Init
nodes.description: Performs comprehensive initialization of the Llama model and its inference context, including loading LoRA adapters, applying control vectors, and executing a warmup run to prepare the model for use.

nodes.label: Format Llama Batch to String
nodes.title: Batch to String
nodes.description: Converts a `llama_batch` structure, containing token data and metadata, into a detailed, human-readable string representation for debugging or logging purposes.

nodes.label: Gather System Information
nodes.title: System Info
nodes.description: Collects and formats system-specific details, such as the number of active CPU threads and overall hardware concurrency, providing insights into the execution environment.

nodes.label: Remove String Suffix
nodes.title: Remove Suffix
nodes.description: Removes a specified suffix from the end of a given string if it exists, returning a boolean indicating whether the modification occurred.

nodes.label: Find Partial Stop Sequence
nodes.title: Partial Stop Finder
nodes.description: Identifies if a string ends with a partial match of a predefined stop sequence, useful for managing text generation termination conditions.

nodes.label: Join String Vector
nodes.title: String Joiner
nodes.description: Concatenates a collection of strings into a single string, inserting a specified separator between each element.

nodes.label: Configure Optimizer Learning Rate
nodes.title: Optimizer LR Config
nodes.description: Sets the learning rate and weight decay parameters for GGML optimizers (SGD or AdamW) based on the current epoch and user-defined data.

nodes.label: Identify Optimizer Type
nodes.title: Optimizer Type
nodes.description: Determines the appropriate GGML optimizer type (e.g., AdamW, SGD) by parsing a case-insensitive string input.

nodes.label: Generate FFN Block Regex
nodes.title: FFN Regex Generator
nodes.description: Constructs a regular expression pattern specifically designed to match and identify Feed-Forward Network (FFN) blocks within the LLM architecture.

nodes.label: FFN CPU Buffer Type Override
nodes.title: FFN CPU Override
nodes.description: Provides a configuration to explicitly assign Feed-Forward Network (FFN) tensors to use the CPU backend buffer type, optimizing memory allocation.

nodes.label: Format GBNF Literal
nodes.title: GBNF Literal Formatter
nodes.description: Formats a given string literal according to the GBNF (Grammar-based Neural Fuzzing) specification, preparing it for grammar generation.

nodes.label: Default Logging Callback
nodes.title: Default Logger
nodes.description: Implements a standard logging callback function that filters messages based on a global verbosity threshold and directs them to the main application log.

nodes.label: System CPU Info
nodes.title: System CPU Info
nodes.description: Provides information about the system's CPU, including the number of available cores and hardware concurrency.

nodes.label: File System Operations
nodes.title: File System
nodes.description: Handles file system operations such as retrieving directory paths and creating directories.

nodes.label: LLM Runtime Core
nodes.title: LLM Runtime Core
nodes.description: The core runtime for the Llama model, providing functionalities for model loading, context management, inference, and system information.

nodes.label: GGML Optimization
nodes.title: GGML Optimization
nodes.description: Provides functions for GGML optimizer parameter management.

nodes.label: GGML Backend Management
nodes.title: GGML Backend
nodes.description: Manages GGML backend operations, including buffer type retrieval.

groups.label: System & Environment
groups.title: System & Environment Management
groups.description: Functions for managing system resources, environment settings, and file system interactions.

groups.label: String & Text Processing
groups.title: String & Text Utilities
groups.description: A collection of utilities for manipulating strings, detecting patterns, and formatting text data.

groups.label: Model Initialization
groups.title: Model Initialization & Configuration
groups.description: Core functions responsible for setting up and configuring the Llama model and its operational context.

groups.label: Optimization & Grammar
groups.title: Optimization & Grammar Utilities
groups.description: Functions related to configuring optimization parameters and formatting grammar literals for language models.

groups.label: Logging
groups.title: Logging Utilities
groups.description: Provides a default mechanism for logging messages within the application, with verbosity control.
